charts.title: Revenue of the health and fitness market in Europe from 2017 to 2022 (in billion euros)
charts.short: Value of the European health and fitness industry 2017-2022
charts.description: The health and fitness market in Europe was worth an estimated 28 billion U.S. dollars in 2022. This is a significant increase in the market size of just over 17 billion U.S. dollars in 2021. This can be attributed to the continued recovery of the industry following the impact of the coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic, which forced the temporary closure of thousands of gyms and health clubs across Europe.

charts.title: Revenue of the fitness industry in Europe in 2022, by country (in billion euros)
charts.short: Revenue of leading fitness markets in Europe 2022
charts.description: In 2022, the revenue of the fitness industry in Germany stood at 4.9 billion euros. Meanwhile, the health and fitness market in the United Kingdom was estimated to be worth five billion euros.

charts.title: Forecast revenue of the health and fitness market in Europe from 2022 to 2026 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Forecast value of the European health and fitness industry 2022-2026
charts.description: The health and fitness market in Europe was forecast to grow in size between 2022 and 2026. Following the impact of the coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic, the industry was projected to show signs of recovery and reach 32.55 billion U.S. dollars by 2026.

charts.title: Revenue of the fitness market in Germany from 2014 to 2022 (in million euros)
charts.short: Germany: revenue of the fitness market 2014-2022
charts.description: In 2022, the revenue of the fitness market stood at 4.9 billion euros. This marked an increase of more than 100 percent on the previous year, indicating the industry's recovery following the significant impact of the coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic.

charts.title: Market size of the gym, health & fitness clubs industry in the United Kingdom (UK) from 2012 to 2022 (in million GBP)
charts.short: Gym, health & fitness club industry market size in the United Kingdom (UK) 2012-2022
charts.description: Every day, thousands of fitness fanatics hit the gym to keep in shape. However, the coronavirus pandemic which swept across the world in 2020 had a significant impact on the fitness industry as many establishments were forced to close their doors to stem the spread of the disease. charts.title: Number of gyms and health clubs in Europe from 2009 to 2022
charts.short: Number of health and fitness clubs in Europe 2009-2022
charts.description: The number of gyms and health clubs in Europe has generally been on the increase since 2009. While there was a slight dip in the number of establishments in 2020 as a result of the coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic, the number of gyms in Europe increased again in 2022, reaching 63,830.

charts.title: Leading fitness club operators in Europe in 2022, by number of members (in 1,000s)
charts.short: Leading fitness club operators in Europe 2022, by members
charts.description: In 2022, Basic-Fit was the largest fitness club operator in Europe, with a membership of over 3.35 million. Meanwhile, The Gym Group, a chain of fitness centers in the United Kingdom, had 821 thousand members across its establishments.
charts.note: Europe; 2022; * Only including facilities that offer training equipment. Read more
charts.source: Deloitte; EuropeActive Number of memberships in thousands

charts.title: Leading fitness club operators in Europe in 2022, by revenue (in million euros)
charts.short: Europe: leading fitness club operators 2022, by revenue
charts.description: In 2022, the leading fitness club operator in Europe was Basic-Fit, with the company reporting a revenue of almost 800 million euros. Meanwhile, David Lloyd Leisure, a chain of gyms in the United Kingdom, reported revenue of 748 million euros.
charts.source: Deloitte; EuropeActive Revenue in million euros

charts.short: Gym membership in European countries 2022
charts.description: In 2022, there were approximately 10.4 million gym members in the United Kingdom. Meanwhile, there were around 5.4 million members at health clubs and fitness establishments in Spain.

charts.title: Number of gyms and fitness centres in the United Kingdom (UK) from 2011 to 2022
charts.short: Number of gyms in the United Kingdom (UK) 2011-2022
charts.description: The number of gyms and fitness centres in the United Kingdom more than doubled between 2011 and 2020, highlighting the booming fitness market within the country. However, the coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic in 2020 created significant challenges for this growing industry as many health and fitness establishments were forced to close their doors to the public. charts.title: Leading fitness club operators in Germany in 2022, by number of clubs
charts.short: Leading gym chains in Germany in 2022, by number of clubs
charts.description: In 2022, the largest fitness club operator in Germany was clever fit. Established in 2004, the franchise fitness chain grew to 450 gyms across the country, more than twice as many gyms as its closest competitor, RSG Group.
charts.note: Germany; 2022; * Fully or partly a franchise operation. Read more

charts.title: Number of members at gyms and health clubs in Europe from 2010 to 2022 (in millions)
charts.short: Health/fitness clubs members in Europe 2010-2022
charts.description: The number of members at gyms and health clubs in Europe reached its peak in 2019, before declining in the ensuing years as a result of the coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic. Following the closure of many gyms in 2020 leading to a steep decline in membership, the number has mostly recovered by 2022, reaching 63.1 million members.

charts.title: Number of members at health and fitness clubs in Europe in 2022, by country (in millions)
charts.short: Gym membership in European countries 2022
charts.description: In 2022, there were approximately 10.4 million gym members in the United Kingdom. Meanwhile, there were around 5.4 million members at health clubs and fitness establishments in Spain.

charts.title: Number of members at gyms and fitness clubs in the United Kingdom from 2019 to 2021 (in millions)
charts.short: Number of gym members in the UK 2019-2021
charts.description: The number of people with memberships to gyms in the United Kingdom saw an increase between 2020 and 2021. In the latter year, just over 9.57 million people had gym memberships in the UK. However, this was following a steep drop in the number of members between 2019 and 2020 as a result of the impact of the coronavirus (COVID-19) on gyms.

charts.title: Number of fitness club members in Germany from 2014 to 2022 (in millions)
charts.short: Number of gym members in Germany 2014-2022
charts.description: In 2022, there were approximately 10.3 million fitness club members in Germany. This marked an increase of over one million on the gym membership figures from a year previous.

charts.title: Number of women in England who participated in sport and physical activity at least twice in the last 28 days from 2015 to 2022 (in millions)
charts.short: Female participation in sport and physical activity England 2015-2022
charts.description: The number of women participating in any kind of sport or physical activity in England slightly increased in 2021/22, rising to around 17.7 million. This represented an increase of just under one percent on the previous survey period.
charts.note: United Kingdom (England); November 2015 to November 2022; 177551 respondents; 16 years and older

charts.title: Number of people participating in sport twice a month in England between November 2021 and November 2022, by sport (in 1,000)
charts.short: England: most popular sports in 2022, by monthly participants
charts.description: Sports in the United Kingdom (UK) is governed by the association UK Sport, which funds and governs various other sport associations. One of these is Sport England, the sports governing body for England. Sport England conducts annual surveys on sports participation throughout England, gathering data on demographics, habits, preferences and more. As of November 2022, running was the sport that most people in the UK engaged with on a monthly basis.
charts.note: United Kingdom (England); November 2021 to November 2022; 177,551 respondents; 16 years and older
charts.source: Sport England Number of participants in thousand

charts.title: Number of people participating in fitness classes in England from 2015 to 2022
charts.short: Fitness class participation England 2015-2022
charts.description: Between November 2021 to November 2022, approximately 5.78 million people participated in fitness classes in England. This marked a slight fall on the number of participants two years earlier, which stood at over 6.3 million.
charts.note: United Kingdom (England); 2015 to 2022; 177,551 respondents; 16 years and older; base varies

charts.title: Most used eHealth tracker / smart watches by brand in the UK as of December 2023

charts.description: With 46 percent, Apple is the most popular brand for personal smart watches and eHealth or fitness trackers among UK consumers. In second place follows Fitbit with 28 percent of respondents. These results are based on a representative online survey conducted in 2023 among 1,685 consumers in the UK.
charts.note: United Kingdom; January to December 2023; 1685 respondents; 18-64 years; respondents who use fitness trackers, smartwatches with fitness function, motion trackers or sleep tracking systems (Housing & household equipment, Internet & devices)
charts.source: Statista Consumer Insights Share of respondents
